problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of F(x) = (1/n)∑ᵢ fᵢ(x). Every component is differentiable, convex, and globally L-smooth, with L > 0. A minimizer x⋆ exists with ‖x₀ − x⋆‖ ≤ R, where R ≥ 0. Strong convexity is not assumed.

problem_class.label: finite_sum
problem_class.details: The objective averages n ≥ 1 hidden component functions. All Params, including n, L, ρ, R, ε, and x₀, are public.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/FiniteSumStrongGrowthConvex.lean: Params, objective, spec.Public, spec.Instance, and spec.publicInput; LongTails/Setups/FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.lean: objective.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: A query selects any component i and point x and returns exactly ∇fᵢ(x), independently of oracle history and seed. Each component-gradient evaluation counts as one call; there is no additional oracle noise or prescribed sampling dependence.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/FiniteSumStrongGrowthConvex.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, and spec.admissible oracle-answer equality; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: gradient_similarity
distinctive_assumptions.details: Global strong-growth condition: (1/n)∑ᵢ ‖∇fᵢ(x)‖² ≤ ρ‖∇F(x)‖² for every x, with public ρ ≥ 1. Consequently, every component gradient vanishes at any minimizer of F.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/FiniteSumStrongGrowthConvex.lean: Params.ρ, spec.valid, and spec.admissible strong-growth inequality.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space equipped with a measurable-space structure.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: For ε > 0, return a measurable point-valued output with integrable objective gap F(output) − F(x⋆) for some global minimizer x⋆.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Require E[F(output) − F(x⋆)] ≤ ε under the execution law. The extracted budget caps the total component-gradient calls for every execution, rather than only in expectation.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/FiniteSumStrongGrowthConvex.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace and Convergence; supplied result budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Smooth convex finite-sum minimization with an expected objective-gap target is established, but the global strong-growth restriction imposes substantial additional structure on component gradients.

descriptionHtml:
Finite-Sum Convex Strong Growth

We minimize F(x)=n−1∑i=1nfi(x) on a finite-dimensional real inner product space E, where n≥1 is an integer. Each fi:E→R is differentiable and convex with L-Lipschitz gradient, L>0. Strong growth requires n−1∑i=1n∥∇fi(x)∥2≤ρ∥∇F(x)∥2 for every x∈E, with ρ≥1. A given x0∈E satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R, where R≥0 and x⋆ minimizes F. The oracle returns ∇fi(x) at a queried pair (i,x). For ε>0, the goal is a measurable output x¯∈E with integrable gap satisfying EP[F(x¯)−F(x⋆)]≤ε, where P is the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈EF(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E, which is equipped with a measurable structure. The algorithm receives E, n, L, ρ, R, ε, and x0.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Component convexity and smoothness). Each fi is Fréchet differentiable everywhere on E. For every i∈{1,…,n}, x,y∈E, and t∈[0,1], fi((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)fi(x)+tfi(y),∥∇fi(x)−∇fi(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥.

Assumption 2 (Strong growth). For every x∈E, 1n∑i=1n∥∇fi(x)∥2≤ρ∥∇F(x)∥2,∇F(x)=1n∑i=1n∇fi(x).

Assumption 3 (Initial distance). There exists x⋆∈E such that F(x⋆)≤F(x)for every x∈E,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R.

The algorithm may query any component index i∈{1,…,n} at any point x∈E; each query returns the exact component gradient. After the allotted component-gradient calls, its output x¯ must be measurable and satisfy EP[F(x¯)−F(x⋆)]≤ε. The gap must be integrable under P. Here x⋆ is a fixed global minimizer; all global minimizers have the same objective value.

comparisonHtml:
On a finite-dimensional real inner-product space, f=n−1∑i=1nfi, n≥1, with convex differentiable L-smooth components and n−1∑i∥∇fi(x)∥2≤ρ∥∇f(x)∥2 globally. A minimizer x⋆ satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R; L,ε>0, ρ≥1, R≥0. Exact indexed component gradients are available. The target is ∫[f(X(ω))−f(x⋆)]dP(ω)≤ε, with measurable output and integrable gap, where P is the algorithm’s probability law. Costs count all component-gradient evaluations, including reuse and inner solves.

import LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.FiniteDimension

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped BigOperators

namespace LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumStrongGrowthConvex

open OracleTemplate

structure Params where
  E : Type
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [innerE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [finiteE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  n : ℕ
  [nonzero : NeZero n]
  L : ℝ
  ρ : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.innerE Params.finiteE Params.measurableE
  Params.nonzero

noncomputable abbrev objective {p : Params} (f : Fin p.n → p.E → ℝ) : p.E → ℝ :=
  FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := Fin p.n → p.E → ℝ
  Query p := Fin p.n × p.E
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput p := p
  valid p := 0 < p.L ∧ 1 ≤ p.ρ ∧ 0 ≤ p.R ∧ 0 < p.ε
  admissible p f O :=
    (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ univ (f i)) ∧
    (∀ i x, HasGradientAt (f i) (gradient (f i) x) x) ∧
    (∀ i x y, ‖gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y‖ ≤ p.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∀ x, (p.n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) x‖ ^ 2 ≤
      p.ρ * ‖gradient (objective f) x‖ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ k seed i x, O.answer k (0, (i, x)) seed = gradient (f i) x) ∧
    (∃ xstar, IsMinOn (objective f) univ xstar ∧ ‖p.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ p.R)
  successful p f output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
      ∃ xstar, IsMinOn (objective f) univ xstar ∧
        Integrable (fun ω => objective f (output ω) - objective f xstar)
          (P : Measure _) ∧
        (∫ ω, objective f (output ω) - objective f xstar ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ p.ε

end LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumStrongGrowthConvex
